text: Janto an Nulaaɗo, tuma Luqmaana wi'annoo geɗal makko on, hari himo rerɗina mo e moƴƴere, o rentina mo e bone: Ko an yo ɓinngel am, wata a kafidu e Alla goɗɗum goo. Pellet, kafidugol Alla goɗɗum goo ka dewal, ko tooñe mawɗe, wonande wonkii faggitiiki on bakkaatu ɓurɗo mawnude, luttinoowo e Yiite.
